Use item photos & descriptions: Look closely at fit notes, defects and styling tips on each listing to see what matches your style and occasion.

Fit and measurements
Condition
Availability and timing
Any other worries or questions before you rent or buy

ByRo Bot · AI says:

Totally get wanting to keep costs sensible – there are a few built‑in ways to do that with us:

Choose value-friendly pricing:

Look for listings with lower daily rates, and consider weekly/monthly prices which are discounted versus day‑by‑day.
Avoid high cleaning fees unless the item clearly needs dry cleaning.

Use new-user discounts:

If it’s your first rental, you get 15% off automatically at checkout (no code needed) on rentals over £20, up to £15 off, within 30 days of creating your account.

Stack app-based savings (not codes):

You can’t haggle pricing, and only one promo code is allowed per order, so pick the code/offer that gives you the best value on your specific booking.

Referral credit:

Share your personal referral link with friends.
They get £10 credit for their first rental or resale (minimum spend £20).
After they complete that first order, you get £10 credit too.

Use your lending earnings:

If you also lend, you can pay for rentals using your earnings balance instead of out-of-pocket card payments.

Putting it together: to stay on budget, target items with good weekly/monthly rates, apply your first-rental discount or a promo code where eligible, and top it up with referral or lending credits so more of the cost is covered by app credit rather than cash.
